decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core drainage technology and compatible product-family logic, and its dedicated product pages in both 2018 and 2019 suggest a stable place in the portfolio.
A floor-level shower drainage system is directly aligned with the firm's stated direction toward low-profile, accessible bathroom drainage and gained stronger website presence by 2019.
As a designer shower drainage product presented as a flagship, it matches the firm's design-conscious positioning and is too central to the brand direction to remove quickly.

The shower element with integrated slope supports easier installation and renovation use cases, making it a valuable complementary system product even if it was only mentioned rather than heavily promoted.

The backflow-protected basement floor drain had a clearly emphasized launch and homepage visibility, indicating meaningful demand in technically challenging drainage applications despite being somewhat outside the bathroom focus.
The air-admittance valve appears more peripheral to the firm's main strategic push toward integrated shower and bathroom drainage systems and showed only limited promotional emphasis.
